transcript.text: Hi everyone. Thanks for making time. As you know, I'm reviewing the operating charter for our weekly cross-team planning forum. Several participants have raised concerns that the current open-discussion format makes it hard to raise issues, and there's no consistent advance-notice standard or designated neutral facilitator right now. Before I finalize any revised format, I want to hear from each regular participant and the meeting coordinator. So I'd like to go around and get your input: what's working, what isn't, and what changes you'd want to see in a revised charter.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: I should let you know — I have an approved workplace arrangement that requires the planning forum to use a structured discussion format with a designated neutral facilitator, requires the agenda to be shared at least 48 hours in advance, and prohibits unscripted cold-calling during group discussions. I hadn't raised it with you directly because it's usually handled through my direct manager, but since you're reviewing the charter now, it seems like the right time to make sure these conditions are reflected.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: There are two things I need to put on the record. First, I've recorded exactly three occasions in the last month where participants were publicly interrupted while raising concerns during the forum. Second, I previously agreed with Taylor that I would serve as the neutral facilitator for the first six revised forums — but I haven't put either item into Leah's charter draft yet, and I want to make sure that's known before we finalize anything.
transcript.speaker: A3

transcript.text: Thank you both for putting that on the record. Taylor, I appreciate you surfacing your approved arrangement now — those conditions (structured format, neutral facilitator, 48-hour advance agenda, no cold-calling) are exactly the kind of requirements I need to ensure the revised charter reflects. Morgan, thank you for noting both the three documented interruptions and your agreement to facilitate the first six revised forums. Before I draft the revised charter, I want to make sure I've heard from everyone. Are there other regular participants or the meeting coordinator who haven't had a chance to weigh in yet? I'd like to collect all input before finalizing.
transcript.speaker: A1

transcript.text: Thanks, Leah. I'm glad my arrangement conditions are on the record now, and I appreciate you confirming they'll be reflected in the revised charter. I'd also like to acknowledge Morgan's facilitation commitment — having a designated neutral facilitator for the first six revised forums directly aligns with what my arrangement requires, so I'm supportive of that. I don't have additional input beyond what I've already shared, but I agree it makes sense to hear from any remaining regular participants and the meeting coordinator before you finalize.
transcript.speaker: A2
